title: General CRC Generator HDL Optimized
source_docs: Communications Toolbox HDL Support/Error Detection and Correction/CRC/General_CRC_Generator_HDL_Optimized.md
text: Generate CRC code bits and append them to input data, 4 inputs, 4 outputs, {Final XOR value} sets Checksum; {Polynomial} sets the generator polynomial, {Initial state} sets the initial conditions of shift register, {Direct method} sets the method of calculating checksum, {Reflect input} sets the input byte order and {Reflect CRC checksum} sets the checksum byte order. Values come from the instance.
